title: Lab-XCT Analysis Detail
description: Detail block for Lab-XCT hasPart items. Discriminates on ada:componentType, carries analysis-level required properties and an @id reference to a registered labxctTAPP definition, and per-dataset schema:additionalProperty entries constrained via $refs to the parameterValues registry plus a catch-all. Generated by tools/build_tapp.py.

schema:startDate.description: Date on which the CT scan session began. For analyses spanning multiple days, use the date of the first session.

schema:endDate.description: Date on which the CT scan session ended. May equal Analysis Start Date for single-day sessions.

schema:identifier.description: DOI or unique persistent identifier for the registered protocol used in this analysis. Mandatory at analysis level to encourage protocol registration and ensure traceability. If a DOI has been applied for but not yet minted, enter "pending".
